```{r}
#filtering data

hotel_booking_city <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "City Hotel")

hotel_booking_resort <- hotel_booking %>%                                                               filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel")

hotel_booking_2 <- select(hotel_booking, 1:7, 15:29)



```


```{r}
#peak seasons

hotel_city_adr <- hotel_booking_city %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%                                                                
   summarise(avr_adr_city = mean(adr))
   
hotel_resort_adr <- hotel_booking_resort %>%
 filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
   group_by(arrival_date_month, arrival_date_year) %>%                                                                
   summarise(avr_adr_resort = mean(adr))

```

``` {r}
# Identifying sectors for non-refundable deposits 
# Sorting Resort Hotel bookings 

resort_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "Resort Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

resort_risk_table <- resort_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

resort_risk_table_sorted <- resort_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

# Sorting city hotel bookings 

city_hb_q3 <- hotel_booking %>%
  filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>%
  mutate(
  lead_time_groups = case_when(
    lead_time <= 14 ~ "Last Minute",
    lead_time <= 90 ~ "Short Term",
    lead_time <= 200 ~ "Medium Term",
    TRUE ~ "Advance Term"
  ),
  risk_group = case_when(
    market_segment == "Online TA" | market_segment == "Offline TA" ~ "External",
    market_segment == "Direct" ~ "Direct",
    market_segment == "Corporate" ~ "Corporate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  )

city_risk_table <- city_hb_q3 %>%
  group_by(risk_group, lead_time_groups) %>%
  summarise(
    total_bookings = n(),
    total_canceled = sum(is_canceled),
    cancellation_rate = (total_canceled / total_bookings) * 100,
    mean_adr = mean(adr)
    
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

city_risk_table_sorted <- city_risk_table %>%
  arrange(desc(cancellation_rate))

```
